ShortDescription.Value: Hides Population number (or demand bars), when not hovering over it. Now Includes Show Text Trend by DanielVNZ

Publish.LongDescription:
Beyond Numbers hides the population number on the city toolbar unless the player hovers over it. It also hides the demand bars in a similar manner. This helps reduce stress when building a detailed city, as the raw numbers are only shown when you actually want to see them.
**Features** (Everything can be Activated/Deactivated in the Settings): - **Hide Population Number:** The population count is hidden until you hover over it - **Hide Demand Bars:** Optionally hide demand bars (Residential, Commercial, Industrial) until hovered - **Hide Time of Day:** Optional option to hide the clock to reduce stress while building detailed cities - **Hide Current Year:** Optional option to hide the year to reduce stress while building detailed cities - **Population Trend Overlay:** A subtle indicator shows whether your population is growing or shrinking - **Money Trend Overlay:** An overlay shows the trend of your city's budget over time - **Show Text Trends Integration:** The "Show Text Trends" mod functionality is now built directly into Beyond Numbers - **Fully Configurable:** All overlays and hiding behaviors can be toggled independently
If you have feedback or suggestions, please visit the forum thread or Discord modding server: https://discord.gg/HTav7ARPs2
Special thanks to DanielVNZ for creating the original "Show Text Trends" mod.
The thumbnail is based on the Thumbnail Style by Luca (mod author of Platter), used with permission.
